blurb: Vintage finds from Trinidad, CO, now online! Come find something weird, wonderful and one-of-a-kind.

story.title: Same Den, new nest!
paragraphs: For years, I have been thrilled to be a part of this special community here in Trinidad and loved having a store front on Main st. A place for unique finds, good times and good chats. Life is shifting to a slower pace so Owl Den is spreading  its wings and moving online. The hunt and love for finding weird, wonderful, one-of-a-kind finds isn't going anywhere-you'll just be finding it here now!
To everyone that has shopped, browsed or hung around, thank you! I couldn't be more grateful you're coming along for the ride.

testimonials.quote: Such a gem of a shop! Got these amazing pajamas that were still in the original package. "styled for smartness and flattery" so I'm wearing them out to dinner! Lovely experience all around. Owner is wonderful! Check this shop out!
testimonials.author: Hannah Cubra

testimonials.quote: What a great find! Cool, eclectic mix of vintage items. Prices are super reasonable. The owner is lovely and did a great job helping my teenage nephew. Well worth stopping in.
testimonials.author: Lisa Flores

testimonials.quote: Owl Den Vintage has what you're looking for but also didn't know you needed. I have collected a ton of vintage shirts and multiple dresses for special occasions. They have everything from records to that jacket you had as a teen.
testimonials.author: Jorie White
